findings.text: the fresh-interpreter precision assertion accepts either 'extended precision: True' or 'refused:', so deleting configure_dtypes() from edge_consistency() -- the review item the test was added for -- still leaves it green because the RuntimeError branch prints that word; it reddens only if both the call and the raise are removed.

the profile_current_ratio assertion compares the reader's integral with 1.0 where the fixture wrote its own Ip from the same toroidal_current_density the reader applies, so the two sides move together and the assertion cannot fail; the stored sources read -1.13, -1.09 and -1.10, so no test covers that sign discrepancy.

the driver imports the private _uniform_axis from nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py:49, so a helper the repository owns is borrowed through a leading-underscore symbol rather than a public one and a rename there silently breaks the driver.

_measure re-implements scripts/edge_consistency_table.py:135 measure_slice (resample, interpolate, integrate), so the tests never run the driver that produced the table and a regression in that read path would leave every test green.

the tests line is a template carrying an unsubstituted file placeholder rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so the gate receipt cannot be re-run from it; the literal commands survive only in the '# command:' headers of gate-base.log and gate-head.log.
